rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say Tuesday.

example.english: We’ll have dinner together on Tuesday.
example.jyutping: sing1 kei4 ji6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this as a colloquial alternative to 星期二.

example.jyutping: lai5 baai3 ji6 nei5 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4

rows.note: Use this shorter form mainly in written, calendar, or news contexts.

example.english: Will the stock market rise on Tuesday?
example.jyutping: zau1 ji6 gu2 si5 wui5 m4 wui5 sing1
